<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000bzHSQAY" target="_blank" rel="noopener">EA Madden Scholarship Program</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: EA Sports | UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Varies<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 20, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to Black/African American college freshmen, sophomores, and juniors who attend specific HBCUs (see website for list of eligible colleges). Scholarship is open to all majors with a preference for computer science, software engineering, interactive entertainment, game design and art.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000rd6UQAQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Charles J. and Mary E. Field Endowment Fund Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: Charles J. and Mary E. Field Endowment | UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Up to $5,000<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 23, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to graduate students who are either attending a UNCF member institution or are a graduate of a UNCF member institution and who are pursuing their graduate degree education.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iVJ00000j6a6wYAA" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Edna Blum Scholarship for NY Residents</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Up to $5,000<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 23, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to students with an unmet financial need attending colleges and universities throughout the United States. Applicant must be from the NYC area (one of the five Burroughs only), be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident, and have at least a 2.5 GPA.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iVJ00000jw7K9YAI" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Eunice Walker Johnson Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Up to $5,000<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 23, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to students attending a UNCF member institution. Applicant must have at least a 3.0 GPA and demonstrated unmet financial need. Priority will be given to students attending Selma University.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000B8GnQAK" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NextEra Energy Scholarship Program – 2 Year Institution Applicants</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF | NextEra Energy<br><strong>Amount</strong>: $5,000.00<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 25, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to first year students who identify as diverse in ethnic background and who are majoring in STEM (excluding healthcare majors) or business a discipline.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000B8lRQAS" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NextEra Energy Scholarship Program – 4 Year Institution Applicants</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF | NextEra Energy<br><strong>Amount</strong>: $10,000.00<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: November 25, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to undergraduate juniors who identify as diverse in ethnic background and who are majoring in STEM (excluding healthcare majors) or business a discipline.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://www.fozainc.org/scholarships.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FOZA Scholarship for Awareness of Maternal Suicide</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: Friends of Zayne Adams – FOZA, Inc.<br><strong>Amount</strong>: $1,000.00<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: December 1, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to Black, Latinx, and Indigenous students in the United States who have experienced maternal suicide due to postpartum depression. Applicant must be attending an accredited four-year institution, two-year community college or trade school.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://hbcuconnect.com/scholarship/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">HBCU Connect Minority Scholarship Program</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: HBCUConnect.com<br><strong>Amount</strong>: $1,000.00<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: December 1, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to minority students who are incoming or current college students at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://tmcf.org/open-scholarships/tmcf-wells-fargo-gap-scholarship/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Wells Fargo Gap Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: TMCF | Wells Fargo<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Up to $1,000<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: December 1, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to current undergraduate students at TMCF members schools who have at least a 2.75 GPA. Applicant must be able to demonstrate financial need.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iVJ00000jj5G9YAI" target="_blank" rel="noopener">UNCF /Congressman John Lewis Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: Civil Rights Coin<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Up to $4,000<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: December 3, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to deserving minority students who are enrolled at a UNCF member college or university.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000dGXxQAM" target="_blank" rel="noopener">UNCF Social Justice Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: $5,373.14<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: December 4, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to students who are from New York, New Jersey, Vermont, and Connecticut who are committed to social justice. Applicant must be African American and be currently enrolled in college with at least a 2.5 GPA. Although all majors are encouraged to apply, those students who are political science, criminal justice or in a course of study toward the preparation of law school will be given preference.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iiM000000DsyfQAC" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Fidelity Scholars Program</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF | Fidelity<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Varies<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: January 28, 2026<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to students ages 16 to 24 who are permanent residents of Florida, Massachusetts, North Carolina, New Jersey, Texas, New Mexico, Rhode Island, Kentucky, Ohio, Colorado, or the District of Columbia. Applicant must plan to attend a four-year accredited, non-profit college or university as a first-time, incoming freshman in their permanent state or residence.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://opportunities.uncf.org/s/program-landing-page?id=a2iVJ00000iirQfYAI" target="_blank" rel="noopener">UNCF General Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: UNCF<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Varies<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: March 31, 2027<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to students enrolled full-time at one of the 37 UNCF member institutions during the 202\6-2027 academic year. Applicant must have a demonstrated financial need as verified by the financial aid office and have a minimum GPA of 2.5.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://www.barrelandflow.com/artandbiz" target="_blank" rel="noopener">art + biz Scholarship</a></strong><br><strong>Sponsor</strong>: Barrel and Flow Fest<br><strong>Amount</strong>: Varies<br><strong>Closing Date</strong>: Rolling<br><strong>Description</strong>: Scholarship is open to residents of Western Pennsylvania who identify as Black or African American, Indigenous, or as a Person of Color.
